prompt:
Subject: A plexus of branching nerves.

Composition: Show a simplified anatomical teaching model of several yellow nerve strands repeatedly branching and reconnecting into an interwoven network across a small tissue patch. Keep the strands visibly continuous and non-graphic, with no electrical circuitry, labels, or claim that they form a single straight nerve.

Style: Use the attached invidious.png for drawing style only. Match its thick rounded dark-brown contours, simplified rounded shapes, and restrained 2D cartoon shading. Do not copy the reference subject or composition.

Framing: One compact composition, with the complete subject using about 80-90% of the square. Keep all limbs and object tips inside the frame.

Output: 512x512 PNG, RGBA, genuine transparent background and transparent gaps. No text, speech balloons, explanatory captions, numerals, labels, logos or watermark.
en: A non-graphic anatomy model shows yellow nerve strands branching and reconnecting into an interwoven network.
ja: 非写実的な解剖模型が、分岐し再びつながる黄色い神経線維の網状構造を示す。
